name: Claude Code Integration

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.x'

      - name: Run Claude Code integration
        env:
          CLAUDE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "Detected @claude comment: ${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          # Replace the following line with the actual integration command.
          # Example: dotnet run --project src/ClaudeIntegration/ClaudeIntegration.csproj --comment "${{ github.event.comment.body }}"
          echo "Claude Code integration executed."
